import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 11;
    static final int INFTY = 1_000_000_000;
    static final int NODECAP = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;

    static class Arc {
        int dest;
        int cap;
        int flow;
        int rev;

        Arc() {
            dest = 0;
            cap = 0;
            flow = 0;
            rev = 0;
        }

        Arc(int d, int c, int f, int r) {
            dest = d;
            cap = c;
            flow = f;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static List<Arc>[] adj = new List[NODECAP];
    static int[] level = new int[NODECAP];
    static int[] cur = new int[NODECAP];
    static int src, dst, sz;
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static Queue<int[]> qpath = new LinkedList<>();
    static final int[] ddX = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] ddY = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int tlim;
    static char[][] matA = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] matB = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] hazard = new int[2];

    static void link(int u, int v, int c) {
        adj[u].add(new Arc(v, c, 0, 0));
        adj[v].add(new Arc(u, 0, 0, 0));
        adj[u].get(adj[u].size() - 1).rev = adj[v].size() - 1;
        adj[v].get(adj[v].size() - 1).rev = adj[u].size() - 1;
    }

    static boolean mkLevel() {
        Arrays.fill(level, 0, dst + 1, INFTY);
        level[src] = 0;
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Arc e : adj[u]) {
                int v = e.dest;
                int rc = e.cap - e.flow;
                if (level[v] == INFTY && rc > 0) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[dst] != INFTY;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int f) {
        if (u == dst) return f;
        for (; cur[u] < adj[u].size(); cur[u]++) {
            Arc e = adj[u].get(cur[u]);
            int v = e.dest;
            int rc = e.cap - e.flow;
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && rc > 0) {
                int df = dfs(v, Math.min(f, rc));
                if (df > 0) {
                    e.flow += df;
                    adj[v].get(e.rev).flow -= df;
                    return df;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (mkLevel()) {
            Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs(src, INFTY)) > 0) {
                flow += f;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static boolean ok(int[] p) {
        return p[0] >= 0 && p[0] < sz && p[1] >= 0 && p[1] < sz && 
               matA[p[0]][p[1]] != 'Y' && matA[p[0]][p[1]] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsPath(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                dist[sx][sy][i][j] = INFTY;
            }
        }
        dist[sx][sy][sx][sy] = 0;
        qpath.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!qpath.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = qpath.poll();
            if (dist[sx][sy][p[0]][p[1]] == dist[hazard[0]][hazard[1]][p[0]][p[1]] && 
                (hazard[0] != sx || hazard[1] != sy)) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int[] np = new int[]{p[0] + ddX[k], p[1] + ddY[k]};
                if (ok(np) && dist[sx][sy][np[0]][np[1]] == INFTY && 
                    dist[sx][sy][p[0]][p[1]] + 1 <= dist[hazard[0]][hazard[1]][np[0]][np[1]]) {
                    dist[sx][sy][np[0]][np[1]] = dist[sx][sy][p[0]][p[1]] + 1;
                    qpath.add(np);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        sz = sc.nextInt();
        tlim = sc.nextInt();
        int px = 0, py = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                matA[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (matA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    px = i;
                    py = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                matB[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
            }
        }
        hazard[0] = px;
        hazard[1] = py;
        bfsPath(px, py);
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                dist[hazard[0]][hazard[1]][i][j] = Math.min(dist[hazard[0]][hazard[1]][i][j], tlim);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                if (ok(new int[]{i, j})) {
                    bfsPath(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        src = 0;
        dst = 2 * sz * sz + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < NODECAP; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                if (matA[i][j] != '0') {
                    link(src, i * sz + j + 1, matA[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (matB[i][j] != '0') {
                    link(i * sz + j + 1 + sz * sz, dst, matB[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < sz; i1++) {
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < sz; j1++) {
                        if (ok(new int[]{i, j}) && ok(new int[]{i1, j1}) && 
                            dist[i][j][i1][j1] <= dist[px][py][i1][j1]) {
                            link(i * sz + j + 1, i1 * sz + j1 + 1 + sz * sz, INFTY);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
